topic: Changes of State and Particle Arrangement
key_concepts: Melting is the change from solid to liquid and requires heat absorption
Evaporation is the change from liquid to vapor and requires heat absorption
Condensation is the change from vapor to liquid and releases heat
Freezing is the change from liquid to solid and releases heat
Absorbed heat overcomes attractive forces between particles
Solid particles are compact and strongly attracted; liquid particles are farther apart; va
Released heat strengthens particle attractions and brings particles closer together
Melting and freezing are opposite processes, as are evaporation and condensation
Not all substances naturally exist in all three states under standard conditions
The water cycle illustrates evaporation, condensation, freezing, and melting in nature
